statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2024-0388 is an informational notice that the derivative crate is unmaintained. It names no vulnerability and no patched release. derivative 2.2.0 is a procedural macro crate that flux-core depends on, so it runs while libflux is built and is not itself linked into kapacitord. Replacing it needs a change in flux, the Flux query engine that Kapacitor links as libflux.
